_comment: Inputs of scripts/relay-researcher-binding.mts, which rebuilds the researcher installation's PodRuntimeBinding and the complete operator definition for runbook step I4 (docs/runbooks/relay-researcher-installation.md) with the pinned Relay checkout's own code. `release` pins the Relay v0.10.3 release (Gitea release 2142) and the sha256 of each asset the generator reads: it refuses any other bytes and any checkout whose HEAD is not sourceCommit. `derived` holds the values the reviewed template's binding leaf requires (researcher-installation-definition.json), plus the relay-gvisor RuntimeClass's scheduling.nodeSelector key ailab.io/runtime-gvisor (RuntimeClass admission merges it into every Pod, and Relay pins the placement selector exactly); scripts/tests/test_relay_researcher_binding.py compares them with the template, relay-workers.tf and the internal TLS and journal manifests. `decisions` holds every binding value that is NOT derived from the release, the template or a Relay constant, as the owner decided them on 2026-11-15 (runbook, 'Binding inputs that are decisions'). `installation` is the identity Relay approved at step I3 (public values; fingerprint = Relay's publicKeyFingerprint, the first 16 hex of sha256 over the base64url key text): the generator refuses any other installation ID or public key, and researcher-i4/ is its committed output for exactly this identity. `agentRelease` pins the Relay v0.10.6 release (Gitea release 2145, source 1599d06e), an agent-only update (owner decisions 2026-11-17, first v0.10.5, then v0.10.6; the installation runbook's "Agent-only update"): only the infrastructure agent image comes from it, everything else stays `release`'s.
